name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold exploration company focused on acquiring and exploring mineral properties and royalty interests in Nevada and Idaho. The company holds interests in multiple projects within Nevada's Walker Lane gold trend, including the Lapon Canyon Project where it holds a 3% Net Smelter Royalty and an Exploration Stream Earn-in Agreement. Nevada Canyon is an exploration-stage company with no current production.
